blocks.text: KING OF JUDAH · TWO KINGDOMS
Amon. Two years in Jerusalem, killed in his own house.
REIGNEDi
2 years c. 643–641 BC (dates vary)
CAPITAL
Jerusalem
HOUSE
House of David 15th of 20 in Judah
VERDICT
✕ Did evil “And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, as his father Manasseh did.”
PROPHETS
None named
JUDAH (THE SOUTH): 20 RULERS REHOBOAM → ZEDEKIAH
SUCCESSION
The two kingdoms
THE VERDICT
How Scripture judges the reign
“And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, as his father Manasseh did.”
2 Kings 21:20 (KJV) →
“And he walked in all the way that his father walked in”
2 Kings 21:21 (KJV) →
BUT ALSO
Chronicles: "Amon trespassed more and more". 2 Chronicles 33:23
CHRONICLES GIVES IT AS
“But he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, as did Manasseh his father”
2 Chronicles 33:22 (KJV) →
JUDAH (THE SOUTH): 20 RULERS
✓ Did right ✕ Did evil ◐ Mixed ● No verdict formula
THE KINGDOM
Jerusalem and the places of the reign
Judah (the south) · tribe of Judah. Only places Scripture names are shown, each where the Atlas puts it.
EVENTS
Wars, works and turning points
UNDATED IN SCRIPTURE
THE NATION
What the nation did
He "forsook the LORD God of his fathers". 2 Kings 21:22
TWO ACCOUNTS
Where Kings and Chronicles differ
Each ribbon joins the two accounts of one matter, passage to passage.
His burial
2 KINGS
2 CHRONICLES
Compared with his father
2 KINGS
2 CHRONICLES
DATES DIFFER
When was it?
SCRIPTURE'S NUMBERS
No years given
2 years (2 Kgs 21:19). Scripture gives lengths and cross-dates, never BC years.

Printed form: 643/642–641/640 (PDF p. 35).
YOUNG (2005), REVISING THIELE

Printed form: c. 642–640 (p. 22).
TRADITIONAL DATES (USSHER, 1658)

IN SCRIPTURE
Every passage
CHAPTERS · 2
2 Kings 21 2 Chronicles 33
PASSAGES · 2
2 Kings 21:18–26 2 Chronicles 33:20–25
WHAT SCRIPTURE DOES NOT SAY
Scripture does not say why his servants killed him.
No prophet is named in his reign.
